about: Profitable businesses with good management at fair prices, held for decades.
summary: 145 holdings; the top ten are 44% of the portfolio.
Trades very little: about 5% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for at least 10.1 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced, more profitable and much larger.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 5 of 9 full years.

profile.background: University of Virginia graduate and former PricewaterhouseCoopers accountant. Joined Markel in 1990, became its chief investment officer, was co-chief executive for over six years and has been sole chief executive since January 2023. Also a director of Coca-Cola and Graham Holdings.
profile.approach: Invests Markel's insurance money in profitable businesses with good returns and modest debt, run by honest and talented managers, with room to reinvest, at fair prices, and holds them for decades.
profile.note: This is the investment portfolio of Markel Group, an insurance and holding company.

name: Thomas Gayner
